description: Generate the meeting dates for a recurring class between two dates, and skip holidays and reading weeks. Inputs: course, weekdays (day names or codes such as Tuesday or TU), start_date, end_date, start_time, optional end_time, optional location, holidays (single dates or ranges) and reading_weeks (single dates or ranges). Returns every meeting date plus the dates that were skipped and why. The answer ends with a next step hint that points to build_ics when the class should become a calendar. Example prompt: "My biology class meets Tuesday and Thursday from Sep 8 to Dec 10, 2026 at 10:00. Skip the reading week of Oct 12 to Oct 16."

course.description: Course name or code, such as BIO 101.

end_date.description: Last date of the term as YYYY-MM-DD.

end_time.description: Class end time as HH:MM or 2:30 PM. It must be after start_time.

holidays.description: Holiday dates or ranges, such as "2026-10-12" or "2026-10-12 to 2026-10-16".

reading_weeks.description: Reading week dates or ranges, such as "2026-10-12 to 2026-10-16".

start_date.description: First date of the term as YYYY-MM-DD.

start_time.description: Class start time as HH:MM or 2:30 PM.

title.description: Title for the calendar event. Defaults to the course name plus class.

weekdays.description: Days the class meets, as names or codes, such as "Tuesday", "Tue" or "TU".

name: expand_recurring_classes

candidate_count.description: How many dates matched the weekdays before holidays and reading weeks were removed.

end_time.description: Class end time, or null when none was passed.

location.description: Room or place, or null when none was passed.

meetings.description: Every class meeting, in date order.

date.description: Date of the meeting as YYYY-MM-DD.

end_time.description: End time as HH:MM, or null when no end time was passed.

location.description: Room or place, or null when no location was passed.

weekday.description: Day of the week of the meeting.

next_step.description: Suggested next tool call for turning the class meetings into a calendar.

skipped.description: Dates that were skipped, with the reason.

date.description: Date that was skipped, as YYYY-MM-DD.

reason.description: Why the date was skipped, such as holiday or reading week.

weekday.description: Day of the week of the skipped date.

title.description: Title used for the calendar event.

weekdays.description: The weekdays as two letter codes.

title: Expand recurring classes
